q: What grid emission factor should a supplier in Oman use for electricity?
title: Oman grid factor for suppliers
short: Oman generates almost all its grid power from natural gas, so the location based factor sits around half a kilogram of CO2 per kWh. Use the official national or IEA figure for the reporting year, state its source and year, and report solar or certificate purchases separately under the market based method.
audience: Factories and exporters in Sohar, Duqm and Muscat reporting Scope 2 to buyers

p: Take the national average factor for the year of the bills. Gas fired combined cycle plants pull it down, older open cycle units push it up, so the figure moves a little from year to year.

If you buy electricity from a named solar plant under contract, or hold certificates that meet the Scope 2 quality criteria, that figure goes in the market based total. Without them, the market based figure falls back to the grid average.

ul: kWh per month from the bills.
The factor, its source and its year.
